notes.title: Big update on 10/16/2024
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings Survivalists!
[/b][/h3]
A major update for Survival Story has been released today, and now we're going to tell you what has changed in the game.

[h3][b]A short list of changes:[/b][/h3]
Interface changes 
Added difficulty levels
Redesigned the beginning of the game 
Changes in the dialog system

[h3][b]And now for more details.
Interface changes[/b][/h3]
The game has completely changed the interface of interaction with the inventory. For your convenience, now the empty bar with the description of items, will not catch your eye. When interacting with items in the inventory, a special window pops up in which you can learn everything about the item you are interested in. Also changed the interface of interaction with the Merchant, campfire and workbench.

[h3][b]Addition of difficulty levels[/b][/h3]
Now before starting the game you will have to choose a difficulty level, which affects the fundamental aspects of the game. There are a total of three difficulty levels on each of which you will be dealt with at different intensities.

[h3][b]Redesigned game start [/b][/h3]
At the beginning of the game, you now need to hit up a few vaults to acquire starter items that will help you escape the burning city.

[h3][b]Change to the dialog system[/b][/h3]
The dialog system has changed quite a bit compared to the game's release. Now over NPCs do not pop up a dialog box, the dialog is now visible on the whole screen and each character has a separate image so that you understand who you are talking to.

[h3][b]Other[/b][/h3]
In the new update, the interaction popups have undergone changes. Previously the inscriptions in different languages were not centered and it looked terrible. Now in all languages all inscriptions appear above the items and characters you are going to interact with.
The Survival Book has been redesigned. The quest section has moved to the main page, your inventory and stats are now displayed in the top left corner of the page. A stats tracker of the zombies you've killed has also been added.
All interface windows are now closed with E or ESC.

I hope that this update will make life much easier for all players and allow more people to enjoy my game.

notes.title: Survival Story will be Released on September 26
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-20Y3dRJD_c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Greetings to the survivors![/h3]
I am glad to inform you that the development of [b]Survival Story[/b] is coming to an end. Now we can tell you the exact release date, [b]September 26th[/b]. A real adventure awaits you, in which you have to collect resources, help other survivors and fight for your life in harsh conditions.

notes.title: A demo version is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916397/58e9334bd4d5b90de2c394165e5719c72d1030f1.png[/img]
[b]Greetings to all the survivors![/b]
I am glad to inform you that now everyone can try Survival Story, because a demo version of the game has been released.
[b]Briefly what awaits you in the demo version:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 unique quests
[*] A huge number of bloodthirsty zombies
[*] Crafting and gathering systems
[*] An open world with unique locations
[*] A large number of survival items
[*] 4 weapons, some of which you will receive only after completing certain quests
[/list]
And also quite a lot of content of a different nature.
[h3][b]Don't waste your time, try the Survival Story Demo![/b][/h3]

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gOar1XHBRL0;full][/previewyoutube]
What the hell is going on? Yesterday, these fucking zombies kicked down my door, if I didn't have a shotgun, then you wouldn't be reading this news now, in any case, I made the decision to try to escape into the sewers, I hope these creatures won't get me there.
Oh, yes, there's a new video on YouTube, there's a lot of interesting things about the map, the new location and everything else, I don't have time to tell you everything now, it will be interesting to watch.
It's getting harder and harder to develop the game every damn day, you'd be surprised, but in a world where almost all people have turned into bloodthirsty creatures, the Internet works much worse than in the good old days.
If this news is uploaded, then it will already be a miracle. And it turns out that if you are reading this now, then miracles happen...

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=o-YMDwU9YgM;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Hello to all the survivors, from a developer who is locked in a house surrounded by zombies.[/b]
I'm still surviving and trying to improve my game every day.
To keep you informed, I released a video on YouTube, and don't ask me where I got the Internet from here.
[b]In the video you will learn the following details:[/b]
[list]
[*] New weapons
[*] The location where wild boars live
[*] Adding cooking and hunting systems
[*] Unique soundtrack
[/list]
You can find out all this in the new video, please watch it, and in the meantime I'll go clear the neighborhood of my house from bloodthirsty bastards, otherwise their fucking screams prevent me from developing games.
